ତୁମ ବାସ୍ନା ଅନୁଭବ କରିବାର ଯୁଗ ବିତିଗଲା।
ସମୟ ସହ ପବନର ଦିଗ ବି ବଦଳାଇଦେଲ;
ତୁମ ବିନା ପ୍ରତି କ୍ଷଣ କିପରି କାଟିଲି, ତୁମେ କ'ଣ ଜାଣ?

ପୁଣି ମୋ ଈଶ୍ୱରଙ୍କୁ ମୋ ପାଇଁ ନାମହୀନ କରିଦେଲ।

before.label: English
before.title: I Am Hurt
stanzas: When you remembered me after so long,
it felt as though you had saved one drowning.
Think sometimes how I passed those moments without you;
even without you, I lived with you.
You came with the wind's gust and sank into every pore.
Ages have passed since I felt your fragrance.
With time you changed even the direction of the winds;
what do you know of how I passed each moment without you?
I am hurt by you, hard-hearted one, and by God too.
I loved intensely; I regarded love as God.
Then you made my own God nameless to me.
What do you know of how I passed each moment without you?
Every night of mine passes in turning from side to side;
on the bed there is loneliness, and talk of you.
Who knows what punishment you have given me in love,
for even in flowing tears I have seen you.
